name: Food Fight
disable: DC 17 Occultism check (trained) to weaken the spiritual energy in the room, DC 18 Acrobatics check (trained) to pluck a floating plate out of the air, or DC 19 Intimidation check (trained) to reprimand one of the ghostly children for their poor behavior; each successful check disables one of four plates
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the room or after all four plates are destroyed. After 1 hour, if at least one plate remains, the haunt reactivates. If disabled, the haunt resets after 1 day and the plates magically reassemble. The haunt is permanently destroyed when the attic whisperer in area D5 is destroyed.
routine: (4 actions) For each plate disabled or destroyed, the haunt has 1 fewer action. On each action, spectral food is flung off a plate at a different living creature in the room. This ranged Strike doesn't provoke reactions. A creature critically hit by a flung food Strike is also Dazzled for 1 round.

items.name: Dinner Bell
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the set table

---
Effect A loud phantom dinner bell rings before the plates begin to tremble and hover. Each creature in the room takes 2d6+2 sonic damage (DC 17 basic Fortitude save save). The haunt then rolls initiative.

text: Ghostly food appears on cracked plates as they float above the table. The faint outline of children can occasionally be seen as the ectoplasmic food is flung throughout the room.
